These interact through a layered feedback loop where script state modulates player value, which in turn affects lineup confidence. Failure modes include overfitting to past performance, misalignment between ownership and value, and ignoring emergent game dynamics. The system must maintain robustness under adversarial shifts in script or defensive alignment.
